criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
evidence: Purdue GIS BuildingShapesZip4 feature 642 is identified in evidence_r11.json and the raw feature snapshot is cited.
The red/blue roof/eaves polygon traced in roof_trace_overlay_r12.png follows the 2023 orthophoto roof perimeter and inner roof edge.
The trace is a roof/eaves edge, not the structural wall footprint; no calibrated wall plan or GIS-to-wall overlay is provided.
findings: Identity is well supported, and roof plan evidence is materially stronger than R11.
The actual wall footprint/courtyard correspondence remains unverified; traced roof edges cannot establish the wall footprint.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
evidence: The saved library root has identity transform at local origin.
The manifest entry places this local asset at [-109.0, 400.1893310546875] m; the prior R11 read-only master review found the marker aligned with that manifest origin.
The 2023 orthophoto trace gives a registered roof/eaves outline, but source geotag photos have unknown heading/roll and do not verify wall registration or facade stationing.
findings: Library/master origin is coherent, but accurate location of architectural walls, orientation, and dimensional fit is not established independently.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: Purdue emergency-plan information supports four building levels; prior source review records a 53 ft atrium and a three-story frame from primary/engineering sources.
The aerial supports the roof/eaves footprint; attributed 2016 photos support a folded, wing-like canopy.
Current geometry uses inferred heights and warp; the builder explicitly identifies these as inference and reports visible differences from source views.
findings: Building scale/story description is plausible and partly sourced.

The distinctive canopy profile and vertical heights are not dimensionally verified; current renders show a flattened/overbroad folded shell relative to the photo, and a dark triangular inset is acknowledged as unverified interpretation.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
evidence: The renders show the expected brick masses, glazed entrance/curtain wall, and large cantilevered red-brown canopy; the photo set directly depicts these broad features.
The renders include a courtyard view and cardinal elevations for inspection.
findings: Window rhythm and wall segmentation remain generic and are not registered against measured elevations.
The source/render comparison shows a major difference in canopy profile and proportions; the courtyard render has an unexplained opaque dark-blue foreground/panel obstruction that masks the facade.
The entrance/canopy composition is recognizable but still approximate.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
evidence: Fresh Blender 5.2.3 reopen validation reports 445 collection objects and 415 meshes, identity root, and no materialless/null-material meshes.
No external image dependencies or missing image paths are reported.
Evidence includes attribution/source URLs, raw GIS/orthophoto references, geotagged comparative renders, top registered roof view, and explicit uncertainty.
Actual SHA matches expected revision: True.
findings: Export and portability checks are strong.
Evidence is extensive but does not include a dimensioned public roof/elevation plan or verified wall registration.
